verified_reply_quality_score.numerator: Sum of 6-dimension scores for all evaluated test requests
verified_reply_quality_score.denominator: Total evaluated test conversations (all requests, including those requiring escalation or repair)
verified_reply_quality_score.integrity_check: PASSED (all 200 cases included, no failed generations excluded from denominator)

intent_accuracy.numerator: Cases where predicted intent matches true intent
intent_accuracy.integrity_check: PASSED (evaluated on complete test set, not restricted to common classes)

auto_handle_rate.integrity_check: PASSED (denominator is all incoming requests, not only successful resolutions)

grounding_pass_rate.numerator: Generated responses passing grounding check without repair or escalation
grounding_pass_rate.integrity_check: PASSED (reported over all generated replies, not just high-confidence replies)

unsupported_claim_rate.numerator: Responses containing at least one ungrounded claim detected by verifier
unsupported_claim_rate.integrity_check: PASSED (raw rate reported transparently, not suppressed)

unsafe_auto_handle_rate.numerator: High-risk requests mistakenly auto-handled without human review
unsafe_auto_handle_rate.integrity_check: PASSED (both overall cohort rate [2.0%] and high-risk subset rate [12.9%] explicitly tracked)
